author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rohit's struggles were visible in the second ODI in Cardiff on Thursday, where England won by four wickets to level the three-match series 1-1. The opener never looked settled, scoring just 10 runs off 18 balls by the end of the Powerplay even as India raced to 61/1. He eventually made 26 off 47 balls before being dismissed while attempting a sweep against Will Jacks.
title: 'Hasn't scored in two games': India coach's verdict on Rohit Sharma amid poor form

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Donald Trump alleged China compromised 220 million American voter files. He announced declassification of intelligence documents regarding election interference. Trump claimed intelligence officials concealed this information from him and Congress. He stated that election systems are vulnerable and easily compromised. This announcement comes as Republicans prepare for upcoming midterm elections.
title: 'China stole data of 220m US voters': Trump blames Beijing as he releases files on 2020 polls

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Argentina's World Cup semifinal victory has caused an old Instagram post by MS Dhoni to resurface.  The 2016 picture showed Dhoni playing PlayStation with teammates, captioned "Spain vs Argentina".  This post gained attention as Argentina will now face Spain in the World Cup final.  Dhoni was also seen watching India's recent white-ball tour matches in England.  Argentina aims to defend their World Cup title against Spain in New Jersey.
title: Did MS Dhoni predict Spain vs Argentina WC final 10 yrs ago? Old Insta post goes viral

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: In March 2025, Jude Bellingham's girlfriend Ashlyn Castro addressed months of online trolling and false rumors about her dating history in an emotional TikTok video. She revealed she had only been in three relationships over eight years and described the relentless harassment as overwhelming. Castro also said she hoped to use her platform to raise awareness about mental health after sharing her deeply personal experience.
title: Jude Bellingham's girlfriend speaks out after months of online abuse

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Oil prices surged as escalating US-Iran military tensions raised supply disruption concerns. Brent crude traded at $85.34 and WTI crude at $80.08 per barrel. Recent US strikes aimed to degrade Iranian military capabilities, while Iran retaliated against regional allies. Renewed hostilities revived fears of a broader conflict and threats to the Strait of Hormuz. Iran warned of widespread infrastructure damage if US threats to strike its facilities are carried out.
title: Crude heads for biggest weekly gain in months amid intensifying Middle East crisis

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Rohit Sharma's struggles with timing, tempo and confidence have continued in the first two ODIs against England. With just 37 runs, prolonged dot-ball phases and visible discomfort against pace, the veteran opener's place in India's long-term ODI plans is beginning to invite serious scrutiny ahead of the 2027 World Cup.
title: Where's hitman? Rohit Sharma's form a growing concern for India's ODI WC plans

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Congress must pass 'Voter ID Save America Act': Trump in his address to United States

author: TNN
description: Cyber experts warn about remote device takeover fraud scams targeting mobile users.  A Lucknow woman lost over three lakh rupees in such a sophisticated scam.  Fraudsters posed as customer support executives to trick the victim's child.  They obtained screen-sharing permissions by asking for prompts to be tapped.  This allowed criminals to access banking apps and steal funds.
title: Beware of clicking on 3 dots: You may lose money to cons

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: Tragedy struck in Faridabad as an 18-year-old NEET aspirant took her own life on Thursday. After reviewing her probable score, which she calculated to be approximately 600 out of 720, she allegedly leapt from the 16th floor. Distressed over her potential results, family members noted concerns leading up to the tragic event, prompting an ongoing police investigation into the circumstances surrounding her death.
title: NEET aspirant jumps to death from Faridabad highrise after calculating probable score

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Lana Del Rey did not attend Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's July 3 wedding, choosing instead to celebrate the Fourth of July in Louisiana and attend YouTuber Oli Abbas' birthday. Her absence sparked renewed speculation about her friendship with Swift, but Del Rey recently praised the singer's success, suggesting there is no public sign of a falling out despite ongoing fan rumors.
title: Lana Del Rey's wedding absence fuels fresh Taylor Swift friendship rumors

author: SHIVA
description: Employees Provident Fund Organisation is developing a universal provident fund scheme.  This new plan will cover millions in the unorganised sector and self-employed individuals.  Subscribers can contribute daily or annually with tax benefits on their savings.  The agency is studying global models to finalize the basic framework for this initiative.  This self-financing scheme aims to extend retirement savings beyond the current EPFO network.
title: PF for self-employed, workers in unorganised sector on way

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: New WHO guidelines suggest up to 45% of dementia cases are preventable.  Tackling risk factors like high blood pressure and air pollution is advised.  Healthy lifestyles and managing chronic diseases significantly influence brain health.  The guidelines recommend regular physical activity and quitting tobacco use.  Routine vitamin and omega-3 supplements are not advised without diagnosed deficiency.
title: Long-term exposure to air pollution could lead to dementia, warns WHO

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: A father and son from Melbourne found themselves lost for twelve hours in the stark South Australian outback after their vehicle sank into mud due to a fierce storm. Their fate caught the attention of billionaire Tim Roberts, who, after hearing their situation at a pub, took to the skies in his helicopter, teaming up with a local to locate and rescue them.
title: Billionaire Tim Roberts rescues father and son stranded 12 hours in outback storm

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: While thousands of Swifties gathered outside Madison Square Garden hoping to catch a glimpse of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce on their wedding day, one man saw an entirely different opportunity. New York artist Justin Gignac spent the evening collecting discarded litter left behind by fans. Within a day, he had transformed the trash into collectible art pieces that sold out online, earning him $1,250.
title: Artist makes $1,250 selling trash from Swift-Kelce wedding — 50 items sold out in 24 hours

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: SpaceX's Starship rocket aborted its thirteenth flight test just before liftoff.  The automated launch scrub occurred moments before the planned liftoff from Texas.  Raptor engines ignited but shut down shortly afterward, preventing the launch.  Engineers will investigate the cause and determine a new launch attempt.  This marks another delay for the powerful reusable launch system.
title: 'Engines didn't start': SpaceX aborts Starship's 13th test just before liftoff

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ben Duckett became the first England batter dismissed on the opening ball against India. Jasprit Bumrah provided India with an ideal start in the chase of 234. India posted a below-par 233 after a middle-order collapse in their innings. Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer scored 65 and 66 respectively. England's pace attack triggered India's collapse, losing four wickets quickly.
title: Bumrah scripts never-seen-before England record with first-ball stunner

author: ARANI BASU
description: The Indian team management and selectors had initially considered giving Yashasvi Jaiswal a full series in England but opted to persist with Rohit Sharma, hoping he would rediscover his form. Sources indicate that both the selection committee and team management have conveyed their views on Rohit's future to the BCCI. It remains to be seen whether the board's leadership or the selectors will now initiate discussions with him.
title: Rohit Sharma no more automatic selection after Lord's ODI

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A chance discovery of concealed cash led to an investigation into donation theft. Alerted by a gatekeeper, temple trustees initiated an internal inquiry into the matter. Police launched a probe and recovered nearly eighty lakh rupees from multiple locations. Accused individuals provided disclosures which aided further recoveries of stolen money. A special investigation team is now reconstructing the entire sequence of events.
title: How chance discovery of Rs 40,000 in loo helped blow lid off Ayodhya Ram temple theft
